title: Instituto vs San Lorenzo: Decisive Clash in Clausura 2026 Round 7
seoTitle: Instituto vs San Lorenzo: Clausura 2026 Round 7 Decider
subtitle: Match scheduled for August 31st, 9:15 PM (Brasília time), promises a tactical showdown between two teams in contrasting table positions.
excerpt: Instituto and San Lorenzo face off this Monday (31) in Round 7 of the Argentine Championship Clausura 2026, in a match that could shift their table positions.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Instituto and San Lorenzo meet this Monday (31) for Round 7 of the Argentine Championship Clausura 2026, at 9:15 PM (Brasília time). The clash draws attention as both teams seek different outcomes in the competition.

Instituto Enters Positive Phase

The home team has accumulated four wins, one draw, and one loss in six Clausura matches, totaling 13 points and tying for the lead with Vélez Sarsfield. Defensive solidity is a highlight, with only two goals conceded, placing Instituto among the teams with the fewest goals against.

San Lorenzo Seeks Consistency

San Lorenzo has had an inconsistent campaign, with two wins, one draw, and three losses in the six matches played so far. In Zone A, they occupy 12th position, six points behind the leader, and have scored only two goals, highlighting offensive difficulties.

Head-to-Head History

In direct clashes, San Lorenzo holds an advantage with 10 wins, 7 draws, and 5 losses against Instituto. In the last five encounters, San Lorenzo won three times, while Instituto secured only one win and one draw.

Probable Lineups

For Instituto, the probable lineup includes Marcos Ledesma; Leonel Mosevich, Fernando Alarcón, and Jonathan Galván; Matías Gallardo, Gustavo Abregú, Diego Sosa, and Giuliano Cerato; Matías Tissera, Alex Luna, and Jhon Córdoba, under the command of Diego Flores.

San Lorenzo is expected to field José Devecchi; Ezequiel Herrera, Danilo Arboleda, Emiliano Amor, and Teo Rodríguez Pagano; Gonzalo Abrego, Ignacio Perruzzi, Nicolás Tripichio, and Matías Reali; Alexis Cuello and Rodrigo Auzmendi, managed by Néstor Gorosito.

What's at Stake

With a victory, Instituto can consolidate its position among the top teams in the table, while San Lorenzo tries to move out of the danger zone and improve its offensive efficiency. The clash also represents an opportunity for Instituto to react after their penalty shootout elimination from the Copa Argentina against Platense.

Where to Watch

Fans can follow the match in real-time on betting sites that offer live streams. It is advisable to check the availability of services before the start of the game.
